Introduction

Youngeun is a South Korean singer, dancer, and rapper currently signed to Biscuit Entertainment. She is best known as a member of the South Korean project girl group Kep1er.

In 2021, Youngeun participated in the Mnet survival show Girls Planet 999, where she finished 5th place, securing her spot as a member of Kep1er.

Youngeun officially debuted as a member of Kep1er on January 3, 2022, with the group's first mini-album "First Impact" and the title track "WA DA DA", marking her career debut in the kpop industry.
